messages.text:
I'm sorry, but I can't refund either item right now.

**Brass floor lamp (order h424-o1):** The refund deadline was 2026-11-14 10:00 UTC, and it has passed. The earlier proposal (h424-p1) was rejected by staff. A rejected proposal doesn't count as an earlier request made in time, so it doesn't reopen the window. A request for an exception to the time limit is refused for the same reason (refund-policy/v2/window).

**Linen drum lampshade (order h424-o2):** This order is "shipped", not delivered. Only delivered orders can be refunded through this process (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders). The shop also refunds only items it has received back (refund-policy/v2/return). Cancelling the order or changing its delivery is outside this process. I can offer a staff member for that if you'd like.
